Lemon Herb Turkey and Quinoa

A bright, simple skillet dinner that keeps well in the fridge all week long and reheats nicely.

Prep Time
15
minutes
 mins
Cook Time
25
minutes
 mins

Course: Dinner, LunchCuisine: MediterraneanTotal Cost: $9.40 recipe / $2.35 serving Servings: 4Calories: 455kcal Author: Sam Lee
Equipment
* Large Skillet
* Fine Mesh Strainer
Ingredients
Herb Mix
* 1 tsp dried basil $0.10
* 1 tsp dried thyme $0.10
* ½ tsp onion powder $0.05
* ¼ tsp black pepper freshly cracked, $0.02
Turkey and Quinoa
* 1.5 lbs. ground turkey 93% lean $6.20*
* 1 Tbsp cooking oil divided, $0.08
* 1 cup quinoa uncooked, rinsed, $1.10**
* 2 cups chicken broth $0.40
* 1 Tbsp chopped parsley optional garnish, $0.10
Instructions
* Mix the basil, thyme, onion powder and pepper in a small bowl.
* Brown the turkey in half the oil, breaking it up, then sprinkle with the herb mix.
* Add the rest of the oil, the quinoa and the broth. Simmer covered for 15 minutes.
* Garnish with parsley, if desired, and serve.
See how we calculate recipe costs here.

Notes
*Any lean ground turkey works here.
**Rinse quinoa well so it isn't bitter.
